name: Domestic Worker Sponsorship

requirements.blocker_text: This requires sponsorship through an MOHRE-licensed Tadbeer centre, covering 19 worker categories (maids, nannies, drivers, cooks, caregivers, etc.).
This requires the sponsoring individual to be married (a 2026 tightening restricts private sponsorship for unmarried sponsors to Tadbeer-mediated, case-by-case MOHRE approval only).

evidence_required.document: Sponsor income evidence and household details

sources.title: Domestic workers - The Official Portal of the UAE Government (Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022)

notes: GENUINE STRUCTURAL DISTINCTION worth flagging: this is a personal-sponsorship route, sponsored by a natural person/household rather than a company — a genuinely different category from every other UAE work route in this dataset (all employer-company-sponsored). All processing runs through MOHRE-supervised Tadbeer centres, covering 19 distinct worker categories. LIVE 2026 TIGHTENING confirmed: private (non-Tadbeer) sponsorship is now restricted to married sponsors, with unmarried individuals requiring Tadbeer-mediated, case-by-case MOHRE approval — a real, dated eligibility change worth surfacing. Sponsor income thresholds reportedly differ meaningfully between private sponsorship (~AED 25,000/month per tier-3 sources) and Tadbeer-sponsored (~AED 10,000/month) — not independently confirmed at tier-1 precision, flagged as a gap. Same structural ceiling as every UAE route: no PR, no citizenship path for the worker.
